audience: teams that track time on tasks and bill clients with Everhour

useCases.title: Start and stop a timer on a task
useCases.text: Search for a task by name, then start a timer on it. Stop the timer when the work ends, and its time is saved as a record.

useCases.title: Log hours on a task for one day
useCases.text: Find the task, then log the duration for one day. Posting again for the same user, day and task sets the duration. It does not add to it.

useCases.title: Review the team's logged time
useCases.text: List the time records of the team for a date range, or of one user or one task. Read the records before you bill a client.

useCases.title: Correct or delete a time record
useCases.text: Find the record of a task, then change its duration, date, task, user or comment. Delete a record that was logged by mistake.

useCases.title: Look up clients and project budgets
useCases.text: List the clients, filtered by name. List the projects and open one to read its users, billing and budget fields.
